renderer: pinned patched projectM-TV source34, macOS GLES + SwiftShader (native ruler), 480x270, mesh 48x32, checkpoint PCM
method: each probe seeds texture in the first frames, then isolates one motion term; the illustrator's backward map (from the exported mesh_field facts) is applied to native frame 6 and correlated with native frame 7 (20 px margin)

blur_orientation.probe: blur-comp: composite ret=GetBlur1(uv) over a seeded top-left patch
blur_orientation.result: patch stays top-left; blur_bank fed GL row order reproduces the native GetBlur1 profile to 1e-4 mean abs error (illustrator previous orientation 2.2e-3)

blur_timing.result: warp output changes every second frame (blur made from the previous buffer, updated after a blur-sampling warp); composite shows blur from frame 1 (previous canvas)

builtin_wave_orientation.result: wave near the bottom in both; per-frame light 469 vs 470 luma units; frames match a reference PCM window exactly only when the waveform aligner's offset is zero

conventions_top_down_screen.rotation: clockwise on screen for rot>0 about (cx, 1-cy)
